title: chatbot build panel: the zh heading 「已构建{{app}}」 runs the verb into the app name (「已构建Library Lending Management」) — add a separator
body:
Filing gate: **① a reproduced UX defect** (class a, public door: the AI build chat). This is the framework half of cloud#3319. The cloud half is PR cloud#3325 in the cloud repo, which asks the designer for an app label in the request's language.

## What is wrong

On cloud staging (test1016, a zh-CN build conversation, 2026-10-27), the build result card's heading reads 「已构建Library Lending Management」. The verb runs straight into the app name with no separator.

The string is framework copy:

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts`, key `chatbot.build.built` = `'已构建{{app}}'`.
- It is pinned by `plugin-chatbot` `buildPanelI18n-7388.test.tsx:115` as `已构建CRM`.

Even with a Chinese name (「已构建图书借阅管理」), the verb and the name read as one word.

## Wanted

- `chatbot.build.built` composes the verb and the name with a separator, 「已构建 · {{app}}」, in zh. Check ja the same way.
- The pinning test is updated to match.

## Reader

The objectstack `domain:ui` lane. One small PR. S. Cloud picks it up at the next pin, and cloud#3319 stays open until then.

Dedup: the cloud#3319 thread found no objectstack card for `chatbot.build.built` separator.
